```{r Libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(here)
library(ggpubr)
```

```{r import data}
OceanWaterQualityFrame <- read_csv("/Users/grambihler/Documents/Data/GitHub/OceanWaterQuality/YSIExoSonde/YSI-code/DataWranglingCode/OceanWaterQualityFrame.csv")

QCOceanWaterQualityFrame <- read_csv("/Users/grambihler/Documents/Data/GitHub/OceanWaterQuality/YSIExoSonde/YSI-code/DataWranglingCode/QCOceanWaterQualityFrame.csv") 
```

```{r Pre-plotting Formatting}
QCMeanDailyValueFrame <- QCOceanWaterQualityFrame %>%
  group_by(variable, date) %>%
  summarise(mean_daily_value = mean(variable_value, na.rm = TRUE))

```


# Preliminary Plotting Before QC
```{r Basic plots - Pre QC}
# line graph of every variable - facet wrapped 
AllVariablePlot <- OceanWaterQualityFrame %>%
  filter(date >= "2021-05-01")%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, 
             y = variable_value)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~variable, ncol = 3, scales = "free")+
  scale_x_date(breaks = waiver(), date_breaks = "1 month",
               date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        panel.background = element_blank(), 
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(0.25, 0.45, 0.25, 0.25, "inch"))+
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"))+
  labs(title = "B2O Water Quality by Variable from 2011-2023",
       subtitle = "Pre-QC: All Outliers Still Present")+
  xlab("Date")+
  ylab("Nutrient Value")
AllVariablePlot

# Save plot
ggsave(filename = "AllVariablePlot-PreQC-2021present.pdf", plot = AllVariablePlot, 
       path = "/Users/grambihler/Documents/Data/GitHub/OceanWaterQuality/YSIExoSonde/YSI-figures/PreQCPlots", height = 12, width = 10)

# line graph of temperature in fahrenheit
TempFPlot <- OceanWaterQualityFramePivot %>%
  filter(variable == "temp_f") %>%
  ggline(x = "date",
         y = "variable_value",
         plot_type = "l",
         xlab = "Date",
         ylab = "Temperature (F)",
         title = "Pre-QC B2O Temperature(F) from 2011-2023")
```

# Preliminary Plotting After Initial Standard Deviation QC
```{r Basic Plots - Post QC}
# line graph of every variable - facet wrapped 
PostQCAllVariablePlot <- QCOceanWaterQualityFrame %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, 
             y = variable_value)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~variable, ncol = 3, scales = "free")+
  scale_x_date(breaks = waiver(), date_breaks = "12 months",
               date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        panel.background = element_blank(), 
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(0.25, 0.45, 0.25, 0.25, "inch"))+
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"))+
  labs(title = "B2O Water Quality by Variable from 2011-2023",
       subtitle = "Post-QC: Data Outside 2-Sigma from Mean has been Removed")+
  xlab("Date")+
  ylab("Nutrient Value")
# Save plot
ggsave(filename = "AllVariablePlot-PostQC.pdf", plot = PostQCAllVariablePlot, 
       path = "/Users/grambihler/Documents/Data/GitHub/OceanWaterQuality/YSIExoSonde/YSI-figures/PostQCPlots", height = 12, width = 10)

         title = "Post-QC B2O Temperature(F) from 2011-2023")

  ggline(x = "date",
         y = "variable_value",
         plot_type = "l",
         xlab = "Date",
         ylab = "pH",
         title = "Post-QC B2O pH from 2011-2023")
```
